dedupeResult: Repository code search returned no existing canonical match for PBS 106.7FM, Brum Radio or Radio Nano by official platform name, domain, submission path or published submission contact before creation. PBS programme-specific mailboxes and physical delivery, Brum Radio's upload form and explicit submission mailbox, and Radio Nano's form and email alternative were consolidated into one canonical opportunity per platform rather than duplicated.
emailVerificationLevel: submissions@brumradio.com and music@radionano.com were verified by first-party publication, syntax, domain alignment and explicit submission purpose. PBS uses its current official form; a historical musicdept@pbsfm.org.au address was recorded only as excluded evidence because current mailbox status was not reverified. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
formVerificationLevel: PBS exposes a first-party international form with stream and download links, optional newsletter consent, a honeypot and visible human-verification CAPTCHA. Brum Radio exposes a first-party one-track direct-upload form and an explicit submission mailbox; no visible CAPTCHA was indexed. Radio Nano exposes a first-party Contact Form 7 upload/link form plus a music mailbox; no visible CAPTCHA was indexed. Hidden and submit-time controls remain manual-review boundaries.
safety: Three legitimate opportunities were queued as needs_manual_review. No email was sent, no form field was filled, no file, biography or press material was uploaded or attached, no physical media was mailed, no newsletter consent was given, no CAPTCHA or honeypot was completed or bypassed, no login was attempted and no payment or submission action was completed.
